description: AI-02 regression: in human-vs-AI play the human defender must get the shooting reactive dialog (enemy_targets_unit_shooting fold-in: Go to Ground / Smokescreen / codex offers) even when the AI's first atomic SHOOT of its Shooting phase runs before Main has attached the new ShootingController (setup_phase_controllers awaits). Before the fix the one-shot reactive_stratagem_opportunity reached nobody: no dialog, the AI idled on 'defender_window' forever. Fixture ork11e_orks_reactive, starting in the Custodes' Movement phase. Setup privileges: P2's detachment is Runt Swarm (GROT SHIELDS answers the Custodes' shooting) and its enemy_ended_move window (SCARPER!) is suppressed for this Movement phase — as if the player had clicked "Don't offer again this phase"; Player 1 (Custodes) becomes the AI, Player 2 stays human. The AI plays its Movement phase and moves into Shooting; when its first attack is declared the dialog must be on screen for Player 2, who declines it for the rest of the phase; the AI then carries on.

steps.script:
GameState.state["factions"]["2"].merge({"detachment": "Runt Swarm"}, true)
StratagemManager.load_faction_stratagems_for_player(2)
PhaseManager.get_current_phase_instance()._window_suppressed["2:enemy_ended_move"] = true
var gc = GameState.state.meta.get("game_config", {})
gc["player1_type"] = "AI"
gc["player2_type"] = "HUMAN"
GameState.state.meta["game_config"] = gc
AIPlayer.configure({1: "AI", 2: "HUMAN"}, {1: 1, 2: 1})
AIPlayer.set_ai_speed_preset(0)
AIPlayer._request_evaluation()
return AIPlayer.enabled and AIPlayer.is_ai_player(1) and not AIPlayer.is_ai_player(2)

var p = PhaseManager.get_current_phase_instance()
return GameState.get_current_phase() == 8 and "awaiting_reactive_stratagem" in p and p.awaiting_reactive_stratagem
steps.comment: the AI moves, enters Shooting and declares its first attack against the Orks
AI-03: the AI recognises the human's decision is on screen

steps.script:
var p = PhaseManager.get_current_phase_instance()
return not ("awaiting_reactive_stratagem" in p and p.awaiting_reactive_stratagem) or GameState.get_current_phase() != 8
steps.comment: the decline reaches the phase and the AI resolves its attack
